title: Shoot and Follow Your Shot
description: Shooters follow every shot to the rim, rebound and score any miss before the next shooter goes, linking shooting with offensive rebounding.

content.objective: Read the flight of your own shot, follow it and finish any miss.
content.setup: Two lines at the elbows; one ball per line.
content.organization: Shooter follows, finishes, then passes to the other line.
instructions: Follow the shot to where the miss will go (usually the opposite side).
If it misses, rebound and finish with a put-back.
If it goes in, catch it before it bounces twice.
Pass to the first player in the other line and join that line.
coachingPoints: Long shots rebound long; short shots short.
Land, then move: do not stand admiring the shot.
commonMistakes: Watching the shot from the elbow.
Following straight to the rim when the miss goes long.
One-hand tip attempts that fly off.
content.safety: Only the shooter goes for the rebound; lines stay out of the lane.
progressions: Add a defender who boxes out the shooter.
regressions: Coach rebounds; shooter just runs to the rim.
variations: Follow to the weak side only.
successCriteria: Every miss rebounded by the shooter.
content.gameApplication: Shooters who follow their shot grab long rebounds that defenders expect to collect.
